findings.summary: The reconcile rule given to the producer omits the [[link]] fields and log phrase that Athena's own repository tests require, so following it literally passes the gate but fails cargo test here.
findings.evidence: athena-cli's Link struct has required fields line and status (no serde default), and ConfirmedLinks::load parses every [[link]]. the_real_log_has_no_condition_a_finding_against_the_confirmed_list requires each link to match a parsed supersession/amend phrase at its line. The planned rule says only 'a [[link]] whose older is the decision and newer the new entry'. This repository is where tonight's D08 failure happened, so the 'add it the first time' goal is undermined here. Fix: Have the section also say to fill the [[link]]'s other fields as the existing tables do (line of the phrase in docs/decisions.md and status amended or superseded), with an 'amends D<n>' or 'supersedes D<n>' phrase on that line. Keep the gate's own message unchanged.

findings.summary: The governing section must be appended outside the `if planned` block; the plan only says 'after the plan block'.
findings.evidence: The run test repositories have planning off (base_script: 'planning is off in this repository'), so closing.plans is empty and planned_paths falls back to the reading's deliverables (README.md). Code placed inside `if planned { ... }` would never run in the criterion-1/3 tests or in unplanned jobs. Fix: State that the call sits after the `if planned` block closes, for planned and unplanned jobs alike, using planned_paths(closing.plans.last(), &accepted).

findings.summary: run_pin_tests.rs is an expected deliverable but the plan leaves it untouched.
findings.evidence: Grep finds no gate dependency in run_pin_tests.rs. The detail-format test at line 1559 is unaffected by a gate-only problem text. The deviation is reasonable but only raised as a question. Fix: Record it as a deliberate deviation in the plan (no pin test depends on the gate), so the verifier does not flag a missing deliverable.

findings.summary: The prompt test checks for 'README.md', which the stored brief already contains through the deliverables, so that assertion would pass without the new section.
findings.evidence: base_script's reader lists deliverable README.md (tests.rs:233), so the stored brief already names README.md. Fix: Assert the section heading '## Decisions that govern files you will change' and 'D02' inside it, not README.md alone.

summary: The plan is sound and fits the request. It runs the existing gate rule in producer_loop on the work tree's change list. candidate_stage commits that same snapshot.change_list(), so both verdicts agree, and the check_and_verify gate stays as an unchanged backstop that ends the job with today's message. The gate uses the existing one-send-back budget, and its text stays out of report_gaps. Only the commit-based caller prints the unreadable-list warning, which keeps the pinned count of 1. The governing-decisions section is appended only to the prompt, as the plan section already is, so brief_sha256 is unaffected. The named functions and fixtures exist (Snapshot::change_list/blob, governed_repo, editing, reconciling_edits, Lines). The changes to existing tests are correct: producer counts 1→2 at tests.rs:2295/2320, and in the retry test 4 prompts with the retry brief at index 2 and a slice cut matching reading.rs:5960. Each demonstration would fail without the behavior. Remaining issues are minor. The brief's reconcile rule omits the [[link]] line/status fields and the amend phrase that Athena's own backtest test requires. The dispatch code must sit outside `if planned`. The run_pin_tests.rs deviation should be recorded. The prompt test should check the section heading, not README.md alone.
